{{short description|American biostatistician}}

'''James Tonascia''' is an [[Americans|American]] [[biostatistician]]. He is the [[Curtis L. Meinert]] Professor of [[Clinical trial|Clinical Trials]] at [[Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health]]. He joined the faculty in 1970 and was promoted to full [[professor]] in 1981.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://professorships.jhu.edu/professorship/curtis-l-meinert-professorship-in-clinical-trials/|title=Curtis L. Meinert Professorship in Clinical Trials|last=Donor|first=Office of|last2=Baltimore|first2=Volunteer Engagement 3400 North Charles Street|website=Named Deanships, Directorships, and Professorships|language=en-US|access-date=2019-02-27|last3=Development|first3=MD 21218 410-516-8631|last4=Relations|first4=Alumni}}</ref>
